newsitem.title: GREECE: Seasonally adjusted M3 and M4 figures for Greece.
newsitem.headline: Seasonally adjusted M3 and M4 figures for Greece.

text.p: Following are unadjusted and seasonally adjusted figures for Greece's M3 and M4 money supply for the last six months.

The figures have been calculated by Reuters using the X-11 seasonal adjustment technique of the U.S. Census Bureau of the U.S. Commerce Department. Variants of X-11 are routinely used to seasonally adjust U.S economic data.
Available monthly data on Greek M3 and M4 for the period December 1993 to October 1996 have been used for the calculations. The Bank of Greece does not release seasonally adjusted figures.

Unadjusted M3 and M4 figures for the last four months are provisional and are subject to change. If they are revised, seasonally adjusted money supply numbers will change as well.
